old_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of an engagement ring nestled in a grey velvet-lined box. The ring features a large, square-cut diamond set in a white gold or platinum band, surrounded by smaller diamonds along the sides. The camera remains mostly static with only minor, subtle shifts in angle and focus, highlighting the ring's intricate design and the sparkle of the gemstones. The background is slightly blurred, revealing a grassy outdoor setting. The lighting is bright. The hands holding the box are visible. The 'BG' logo is visible on the inside of the lid.
original_wisa_caption: The video begins with a close-up shot of an engagement ring nestled in a black velvet-lined box. The ring features a large, square-cut diamond set in a silver band, surrounded by smaller diamonds along the sides. The camera slowly pans around the box, showcasing the ring from various angles, highlighting its intricate design and the sparkle of the gemstones. The background is slightly blurred, revealing a grassy outdoor setting with some trees, suggesting a natural environment. The lighting is bright, indicating it might be daytime. The camera movement is smooth, focusing on the ring's details while providing a clear view of its beauty. There are no other objects or characters present in the video, keeping the focus solely on the engagement ring and its elegant presentation.
caption: A hand holds an open, gray velvet-lined ring box outdoors against a blurred green-grass background. Inside the box sits a ring with a cushion-cut, faintly blue-tinted center stone held by four prongs, mounted on a pavé-diamond band. The box and ring are already in motion, shifting the viewing angle gradually from a three-quarter side view toward a more frontal perspective. As the box tilts, the inner lid comes into view at the top of the frame, revealing a diamond-shaped 'BG' logo. Specular highlights and facet sparkle on the center stone and pavé band shift position and intensity, including brief bright and greenish flashes. The box drifts within the frame from a lower, right-weighted position to a more centered one, while the holding fingers remain visible at the edges. The ring stays securely seated in the velvet slot throughout the excerpt, untouched and not removed.
